_meta.description: Reverse map: Bengali-Assamese script → Roman/Latin for Bishnupriya Manipuri (BPM)

structure.warning: This file's top-level keys are CONTRACT with the engine and REST layer. Do not rename, add, or remove sections without updating all four hardcoded locations: SECTION_ORDER in assets/js/engine.js, both flatten_map() call arrays in includes/class-engine.php (forward and reverse), the $sections array in includes/class-rest.php, and SECTION_LABELS in assets/js/admin.js.

section_roles.independent_vowels: Stand-alone vowel characters appearing at word/syllable start or after another vowel. Engine emits these directly.
section_roles.consonants: All consonant tokens including pre-formed conjuncts. Conjuncts (multi-codepoint sequences) must appear before their component consonants so longest-match wins. The engine builds consonants_set from this section — do not put diacritics or modifier symbols here.
section_roles.matras: Dependent vowel signs (vowel diacritics) applied after a consonant. The engine builds matras_set from this section.
section_roles.special: Standalone modifier symbols: anusvara (ং), visarga (ঃ), chandrabindu (ঁ), and virama (্). Virama maps to empty string — the engine uses this to suppress its own insertion during reverse transliteration. These must not be in consonants or the engine will misapply cluster logic.
section_roles.punctuation: Sentence-ending and typographic punctuation. Multi-character Unicode sequences (e.g. ॥) must appear before single-character prefixes (।) so longest-match wins. ASCII punctuation (!, ?, etc.) passes through unchanged in reverse and does not need entries here.

format_rules.pair_format: Each section is an ordered array of [from, to] pairs. Both elements must be strings.
format_rules.match_priority: The engine applies longest-match-first scanning across the entire flattened map. Within the same token length, order of pairs inside each section — and SECTION_ORDER — determines which match wins.
format_rules.conjuncts_first: Multi-codepoint conjunct sequences in consonants (e.g. ক্ষ, জ্ঞ) must appear before their component single-codepoint consonants. If ক appears before ক্ষ, the engine matches ক first and the conjunct is never reached.
format_rules.unicode_escapes: Use actual Unicode characters in 'from' values for readability. \u09CD (virama ্) is an exception where the escape is clearer.

engine_contract.consonants_set: Built by section_keys(map, 'consonants') in PHP and sectionKeySet(map, 'consonants') in JS. Used to identify consonant clusters during reverse scanning.
engine_contract.matras_set: Built by section_keys(map, 'matras') in PHP and sectionKeySet(map, 'matras') in JS. Used to identify dependent vowel signs following a consonant.
engine_contract.virama_entry: The ['্', ''] pair in special is required. It tells the engine to consume the virama codepoint and emit nothing, preventing raw ্ from appearing in Roman output.
engine_contract.context_next_token_in: Snippet rules may reference section names via this field. Valid values are the six required_sections names above.

design_notes.simplified_vowels: Independent vowels and matras intentionally use simplified Roman targets: ই/ঈ both → 'i', উ/ঊ both → 'u', অ/ও both → 'o', া/ি/ী all use short forms. This reflects practical BPM roman usage where long/short vowel distinctions are not typically marked. Roundtrip fidelity for these pairs is intentionally sacrificed for readability.
design_notes.conjuncts: Common BPM conjuncts are listed explicitly at the top of consonants so they reverse as a single Roman token rather than as two consonants with a virama artifact.

changelog.3.0: Rebuilt from practical BPM usage list. Simplified vowel targets (ই/ঈ→i, উ/ঊ→u, অ/ও→o). Updated consonant targets to match forward map v4.0 (ছ→s, ঞ→ng, ট→t, ড→d, ণ→n, য→z, ৰ→r, ড়→r). Added conjuncts block at top of consonants. Moved ং/ঃ/ঁ from consonants to special with updated targets (ng, :, ^). Removed র (not used in BPM). Deduplicated য়.
changelog.2.0: Initial structured version with section format.
